# Issue #206 structured fixtures

These ASiC-S, ASiC-E and RFC 4998 fixtures are deterministic and synthetic.
They are generated by `scripts/generate-structured-fixtures.mjs` from the
non-secret contributed CMS/timestamp corpus. They contain no production
identity or private key.

- `issue-206-single.asics`: one PDF and a detached CAdES/CMS signature.
- `issue-206-multi.asice`: PDF + XML, detached CMS and XML reference metadata.
- `issue-206-invoice.ers`: one archive timestamp carrying the contributed RFC
  3161 token for `invoice.pdf`.
- `issue-206-truncated.ers`: negative truncation case.

JWS verification keys and signatures are generated ephemerally inside the test
process, so no test private key is committed or detected by secret scanning.
